rates.SERIES_CODE: chart-history, chart-corridor, kpi:effective, insight:corridor — selects the policy rate, effective yield, windows and SHIR
rates.TIME_PERIOD: chart-history, chart-recent, chart-per-year, chart-cycles, chart-holds, kpi:days
rates.OBS_VALUE: chart-history, chart-recent, chart-cycles, chart-holds, chart-corridor, kpi:rate, kpi:prime, kpi:last_change
rates.FREQ: skip: constant D (daily) for every series in this dataflow
rates.IR_FV_TYPE: skip: one-to-one with SERIES_CODE (the rate type code)
rates.PUB_WEBSITE: skip: constant Y (published on the BoI site)
rates.UNIT_MEASURE: skip: constant PT (percent), stated in every label
rates.RELEASE_STATUS: skip: release-status code, constant YP in the data
rates.SERIES_NAME_HE: skip: BoI's long series name; the page reads five fixed series codes and gives them short labels
